name: gamenet_refresh_player_list_menu
description: GameNet::RefreshPlayerListMenu forwards a player row to the HUD stats triplet so the scoreboard list menu is rebuilt from that row.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet scoreboard/HUD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414390 validates loading g_HudUiMgrStatsList, reading its triplet at offset 0x34, passing the GameNetPlayerRow argument through to HudUiTriplet::AddEntry, and returning void.
The native scoreboard snapshot smoke calls RefreshPlayerListMenu for two rows and verifies the resulting triplet scoreboard entry order after packet-driven score/lap updates.
